title: Explain why a finding is in the 'now' bucket
prompt: unpatched put CVE-2024-21762 on my FortiOS 7.2.5 firewall (internet-facing) in the "now" bucket. Explain why, using the rule ids, and say what the evidence from each source is.

reference.answer.md: Rules: UNP-KEV (in CISA KEV since 2024-02-09, known ransomware use), UNP-SSVC-ACTIVE, UNP-EPSS, UNP-CVSS and UNP-EXPOSED (internet-facing). Evidence: the CVE.org record says 7.2.0 to 7.2.6 is affected; NVD says >= 7.2.0 and < 7.2.7. Both say affected, so the verdict is affected. Fix: upgrade to 7.2.7 or later.
